devices and digitalised data sharing.

  vitals monitoring and vision screening

  workflows

  outcomes

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

[All Early Phase Clinical Services][140]

BIOANALYTICAL SCIENCE SPOTLIGHT

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

CLINICAL RESEARCH SPOTLIGHT

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

[Other Expertise Areas][156]

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

phases of drug development.

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to

# We are Committed to Life

[More][106]
[

### Vision

We strive to transform Fresenius Kabi in the decade to come. We are committed to increase
efficiencies in the therapy and care of patients and improve access to high-quality healthcare
around the globe.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][107]
[

### Excellence

We are specialized in lifesaving medicines and technologies for critically and chronically ill
patients. With our passion and expertise, we touch the lives of almost 450 million people every
year, each one representing the importance of our work.

[healthcare professionals in action]
][108]
[

### Sustainability

We constantly strive to improve our sustainability footprint. For us, meeting the needs of patients
and healthcare professionals goes hand in hand with responsible and ethical management.

[nurse taking hand of woman]
][109]
[

### Think Beyond: Latest Evidence for Effective Therapies in CKD

Join experts at the Global Renal Nutrition Webinar on June 16, 2026. Explore ERA 2026 insights,
protein‑reduced diets, and targeted CKD nutrition.
[Global Kidney Nutrition Webinar Key Visual]
][110]
[

### Women Who Shaped Us

At Fresenius Kabi, colleagues worldwide share personal stories for International Women’s Day,
honoring the women who shaped their courage and purpose.
[Images of Fresenius Kabi employees being interviewed on international womens day.]
][111]
[

Fresenius Kabi has been certified by Top Employers Institute as a Top Employer for 2026 in 13
countries and additionally two regions.
[Image showing the top employer 2026 seals of the 13 countries and 2 regions.]
][112]
[

Female scientists from Biopharma, MedTech, Nutrition and Pharma share their stories and advice,
showing how science careers impact patient care and innovation.
[Image of women in science.]
][113]

Discover how people make the difference.

and gadgets.]

# Advancing science.
# Amplifying impact.

[ What We Do ][201]

Grifols is a leading global healthcare company. Our trusted and innovative plasma-derived medicines,
other biopharmaceuticals and solutions in transfusion medicine enable millions of patients around
the world to lead more productive lives.

Since our founding in 1909, our ever-growing mastery of plasma, diagnostics and life sciences,
backed by our ethical leadership and industry-leading quality and safety standards, have contributed
to a healthier and more sustainable society.

## TIME and Forbes rank us among the world’s best companies

TIME magazine has recognized Grifols as one of the world’s top companies for the third consecutive
year. Additionally, for the second year in a row, Forbes has named Grifols one of the World’s Best
Employers.

This achievement reflects our relentless commitment to our people and long-term impact.

## Latest news

immunoglobulins

July 16, 2026

alpha1-antitrypsin deficiency

June 29, 2026

Read Release
[ Read Release ][204]

## Barcelona honors Víctor Grífols i Lucas

The Barcelona City Council has named the street where the company’s institutional headquarters is
located after Víctor Grífols i Lucas. This tribute recognizes a pioneer in the biomedical industry
who, for more than six decades, was the heart and driving force behind Grifols. Uncover the story
behind Grifols’ legacy.

[ Read more ][206]

## Commitment to people and the planet

Aligned with the United Nations plan to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals defined in its
2030 Agenda, we work every day to do more and do better to contribute to the health and quality of
life of people around the world.

The patients we serve are able to lead better lives. Patients inspire the work we do every day.

[ Read more ][207]
Innovation

## Scientific innovation at work

Our deep and expanding knowledge of plasma and the life sciences is helping us better understand
human health and research potential treatments to improve it.

[ Read more ][208]

## Get to know us

Our history

We trace our roots back to 1909 when Dr. Josep Antoni Grifols i Roig founded a clinical analysis
laboratory in Barcelona, the precursor to Laboratorios Grifols.

Grifols' mission, to improve people's health and well-being, has patients, donors and society at the
heart of everything we do.

# Advancing science.
# Amplifying impact.

[ What We Do ][201]

Grifols is a leading global healthcare company. Our trusted and innovative plasma-derived medicines,
other biopharmaceuticals and solutions in transfusion medicine enable millions of patients around
the world to lead more productive lives.

Since our founding in 1909, our ever-growing mastery of plasma, diagnostics and life sciences,
backed by our ethical leadership and industry-leading quality and safety standards, have contributed
to a healthier and more sustainable society.

## TIME and Forbes rank us among the world’s best companies

TIME magazine has recognized Grifols as one of the world’s top companies for the third consecutive
year. Additionally, for the second year in a row, Forbes has named Grifols one of the World’s Best
Employers.

This achievement reflects our relentless commitment to our people and long-term impact.

## Barcelona honors Víctor Grífols i Lucas

The Barcelona City Council has named the street where the company’s institutional headquarters is
located after Víctor Grífols i Lucas. This tribute recognizes a pioneer in the biomedical industry
who, for more than six decades, was the heart and driving force behind Grifols. Uncover the story
behind Grifols’ legacy.

[ Read more ][206]

## Commitment to people and the planet

Aligned with the United Nations plan to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals defined in its
2030 Agenda, we work every day to do more and do better to contribute to the health and quality of
life of people around the world.

The patients we serve are able to lead better lives. Patients inspire the work we do every day.

[ Read more ][207]

Our deep and expanding knowledge of plasma and the life sciences is helping us better understand
human health and research potential treatments to improve it.

Our history

We trace our roots back to 1909 when Dr. Josep Antoni Grifols i Roig founded a clinical analysis
laboratory in Barcelona, the precursor to Laboratorios Grifols.

## We make it possible.

# You make it matter.

Haemonetics provides a suite of innovative medical technology solutions that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We challenge ourselves to think big and make new possibilities
a reality, so that our customers can make it matter for patients, every single day

[Haemonetics]
[Hospitals]

## Advancing Patient Care at Hospitals

We provide hospitals with quality solutions designed to enhance clinical outcomes, improve
procedural effectiveness and advance healthcare standards.

[Learn More][78]
[Plasma BU website]

## Optimizing Operations for Plasma Centers

We offer innovative technologies that enable higher plasma yield collections, help improve
productivity and quality in our customers’ centers, and enhance the overall donor experience.

[Learn More][79]
[Blood]

## Driving Efficiency for Blood Centers

We advance products and services to help ensure blood safety, improve operational efficiency and
collect the blood components in the greatest demand.

[Learn More][80]
[join our team]

CAREERS

## Join Our Winning Team

At Haemonetics, the work you do matters. Join us in advancing healthcare while you advance your own
career and make your ideas, commitment and passion matter every day.

[Learn how you can make it matter][81]
[making a difference]

OUR MISSION

## Making Our Work Matter

We develop innovative medical technology products and services that improve the quality,
effectiveness and efficiency of care. We are building a collaborative, performance-driven culture
that attracts and develops the best talent.

[See what drives us][82]
[guided by purpose]

CORPORATE RESPONSIBILITY

## Guided by Purpose

At Haemonetics, our Purpose inspires the important work we do every day to meaningfully advance
patient care and drive greater possibilities in healthcare. How we do this work is equally
important. We are guided by our Purpose, and mindful of our shareholders, customers, employees and
other key stakeholders whose trust we value. We are committed to being a good corporate citizen and
take responsibility to proactively identify and manage the environmental, social and governance
risks and opportunities that are relevant to our business and those we serve.

[Learn More][83]

  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Where Complex Medicine Becomes Clear Action

**Join thousands of clinicians and motivated learners transforming overwhelming medical information
into practical health solutions.**

Medical knowledge shouldn’t require three doctorates to understand. Here, research papers become
protocols. Complex mechanisms become clear explanations. Theory becomes practice. Whether you’re a

# The Education Hub That Bridges Every Gap

You’ve got seven minutes with a patient to explain why their mitochondria matter. You’re reading
research at midnight trying to understand your own labs. You know there’s more to health than what
fits in a prescription pad. You sense that how we’re designed matters as much as how we’re broken.

This is why BentleyMD exists.

Three doctorates’ worth of training. Decades of clinical practice. Thousands of hours synthesizing
research. All distilled into what actually moves the needle in human health. No ivory tower
theories. No wellness fads. Just rigorous science that honors both evidence and design, bridging
faith and physiology without compromising either.

Every week, new content emerges as science advances and real questions arise from real practice.
From free newsletters to comprehensive certification courses, from five-minute patient handouts to
deep-dive physiology modules—this is your reservoir for understanding how bodies actually work and
what actually works for bodies.

A place where healthcare providers sharpen their practice, motivated learners understand their own
bodies, and seekers see how faith and science work together—making complex science clear, practical,
and life-changing for every learner.

* Complex concepts simplified into 5-minute patient explanations
* Evidence-based protocols you can implement immediately
* Teaching tools, templates, and handouts ready to use

*Understand Your Body Like Never Before*
* Decode your own lab work and health markers
* Learn what your doctor might not have time to explain
* Access the same information physicians use, translated clearly
* Take ownership of your health with actual understanding

### **For Those Seeking Deeper Truth**

*Where Faith and Science Strengthen Each Other*
* Explore how we’re designed to thrive, not just survive
* Understanding healing through the lens of creation
* Science that acknowledges the soul
* “Vessels That Thrive” principles integrated throughout

# About Dr. Ryan Bentley

**Physician. Professor. Synthesist.**

Dr. Ryan Bentley holds three doctorates and a single mission: to help people unlock their body’s
remarkable capacity for health. As a board-certified Family Medicine physician, professor, and
author, he bridges rigorous science with real-world application—making complex research simple,
practical, and life-changing.

Whether teaching future doctors, writing books, or guiding patients from professional athletes to
those managing chronic conditions, Dr. Bentley sees the complete picture. Genetics, lifestyle, and
faith all inform his holistic approach, empowering people to stop fighting against their design and
start thriving with it.

[About Ryan][20][Contact Ryan][21]

Dr. Bentley, a dedicated physician of faith, is the proprietor and practitioner at Vitalis-Health, a
healthcare institution deeply committed to serving the communities of Holland and the Midwest with
exceptional health and regenerative medicine services.

Our unwavering commitment lies in prioritizing courtesy, comfort, and the prompt delivery of precise
diagnostics and therapies right from your initial interaction with us. Our meticulously maintained
and welcoming environment ensures your comfort as we equip you with state-of-the-art techniques in
lifestyle, preventative, and regenerative medicine.

At Vitalis-Health, we provide direct primary care, unmatched diagnostic precision, and pioneering
treatment approaches that transcend conventional norms within our region.

[View Website][22]

Dr. Bentley is the CO-Founder and Medical Directory of Humarian. Humarian uniquely formulated a
Probonix line of probiotics to address the needs of their patients and those suffering from a
variety of health conditions.

# Advanced care for *lasting* vitality.

## What Is Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE)?

Your blood carries more than oxygen and nutrients. It carries signals—proteins, antibodies, and
byproducts that influence how your body functions, recovers, and ages. Over time, some of these can
build up faster than your body clears them. Therapeutic Plasma Exchange, or TPE, separates and
replaces your plasma, helping reduce that burden and creating a cleaner environment for your body to
work from.

OUR MISSION:

# EXTENDING LIVES >>> EXPANDING POSSIBILITIES

We show up every day to expand what’s possible for clinicians in the care they deliver ... and for
patients in the lives they live.

## The next evolution of a kidney care legacy

Introducing Vantive, a newly independent healthcare company focused on vital organ therapies. Over
the last seven decades, we have built a legacy of exceptional kidney care products and services. Now
we are deepening our commitment to elevating the patient and clinician dialysis experience through
digital solutions and advanced services while evolving our organ support therapies to go beyond
kidney care.

[Patient lifestyle]

## Prioritising the patient and the clinician

Longer, fuller, richer lives — that is what Vantive aspires to make happen for patients everywhere.
This is why we collaborate with our clinician partners to energise innovation and evolve best
practices. From therapies that expand possibilities, to digital solutions that unlock efficiencies,
to advanced services that enhance the therapy experience, we continually work to transform vital
organ therapies in areas that can make a significant impact for patients and their care teams.

[A lady and her granddaughter together in a rose garden]

### Therapies

Innovative therapies to support the kidneys.

[ Learn more ][92]
[A female doctor stands in a hospital, with her back to a computer screen, with natural light
streaming in from windows behind her.]

### Products

State-of-the-art products that clinicians use to deliver optimal therapy.

[ Learn more ][93]
[A woman in scrubs holding a tablet in an office environment]

### Digital Solutions

Connected technologies that optimise therapy administration and enable better outcomes.

[ Learn more ][94]
[A woman in a lab coat engaging with her audience during a discussion]

### Advanced Services & Education

Service offerings that elevate the patient and clinician experience.

[ Learn more ][95]

## At Vantive, we're championing what's most vital

We exist to *extend* lives. To *empower* the people who live them, and the clinicians who protect
them. To give everyone — patients, their families and their clinicians — better options for their
care. We show up every day to expand possibilities for clinicians in the therapies they deliver …
and for patients in the lives they live. To not let a diagnosis become a definition.** **To redefine
kidney care and beyond.

[ Learn more about who we are ][96]
[A nurse attentively converses with an elderly woman]
[ Learn more about who we are ][97]

## Contact Us

Let us know what products, digital solutions and advanced services we can tell you more about.

OUR MISSION:

# EXTENDING LIVES >>> EXPANDING POSSIBILITIES

We show up every day to expand what’s possible for clinicians in the care they deliver ... and for
patients in the lives they live.

## The next evolution of a kidney care legacy

Introducing Vantive, a newly independent healthcare company focused on vital organ therapies. Over
the last seven decades, we have built a legacy of exceptional kidney care products and services. Now
we are deepening our commitment to elevating the patient and clinician dialysis experience through
digital solutions and advanced services while evolving our organ support therapies to go beyond
kidney care.

[Patient lifestyle]

## Prioritising the patient and the clinician

Longer, fuller, richer lives — that is what Vantive aspires to make happen for patients everywhere.
This is why we collaborate with our clinician partners to energise innovation and evolve best
practices. From therapies that expand possibilities, to digital solutions that unlock efficiencies,
to advanced services that enhance the therapy experience, we continually work to transform vital
organ therapies in areas that can make a significant impact for patients and their care teams.

[A lady and her granddaughter together in a rose garden]

### Therapies

Innovative therapies to support the kidneys.

[ Learn more ][92]
[A female doctor stands in a hospital, with her back to a computer screen, with natural light
streaming in from windows behind her.]

### Products

State-of-the-art products that clinicians use to deliver optimal therapy.

[ Learn more ][93]
[A woman in scrubs holding a tablet in an office environment]

### Digital Solutions

Connected technologies that optimise therapy administration and enable better outcomes.

[ Learn more ][94]
[A woman in a lab coat engaging with her audience during a discussion]

### Advanced Services & Education

Service offerings that elevate the patient and clinician experience.

[ Learn more ][95]

## At Vantive, we're championing what's most vital

We exist to *extend* lives. To *empower* the people who live them, and the clinicians who protect
them. To give everyone — patients, their families and their clinicians — better options for their
care. We show up every day to expand possibilities for clinicians in the therapies they deliver …
and for patients in the lives they live. To not let a diagnosis become a definition.** **To redefine
kidney care and beyond.

[ Learn more about who we are ][96]
[A nurse attentively converses with an elderly woman]
[ Learn more about who we are ][97]

## 
## Your Health,
## Our Mission

### **Functional Medicine in Minneapolis**

An MD-directed, root-cause based, medical perspective that uses advanced testing and systems-based
thinking to understand and treat underlying drivers of disease.

### **Integrative** **Care**

A care model that combines conventional medicine with evidence-informed complementary therapies to
optimize overall health and healing.

### **A Holistic Approach**

An approach that considers the whole person—body, mind, and lifestyle—when preventing and treating
illness.

Lifespan Health is a patient-centered, physician-directed integrative health center, equipped to
address your complex medical condition and to optimize your health, vitality, performance and
longevity.

## Our Advanced Approach to Your Health

[Lifespan Health Building, Functional Medicine in Minneapolis][Lifespan Health Building, Functional
Medicine in Minneapolis]

**With so many functional medicine providers and clinics these days, both onsite and virtual, it can
be difficult to choose the right one for your care. Below are a few of the things that make the
Lifespan Health clinic and providers unique in the Minneapolis/St Paul area.**

[Doctor and patient shaking hands, to represent Functional Medicine in Minneapolis][Doctor and
patient shaking hands, to represent Functional Medicine in Minneapolis]

Lifespan Health]

### Physician-Operated

Dr. Mark Rawson, MD, founded and directs a Functional Medicine center that adheres to rigorous
medical practice standards–elevated to address today’s complex health conditions in advanced ways.

### Holistic Focus

We offer a systems-based, whole person approach to health, that emphasizes the combination genetics,
nutrition, activity, sleep, stresses, exposures and other epigenetic factors that unique to each
person, and require a personalized approach to wellness.

### Evidence-based

All that we do and recommend is science and research-informed, clinically-proven, safe, and
non-toxic. This combination of requirements assures you that your treatments and protocols have been
thoroughly vetted and are chosen and performed by licensed providers, who have been extensively
trained.

### Full Practice Scope

As a board-certified physician, with over 30 years of clinical practice, Dr. Rawson has the
experience and licensure to provide patients with comprehensive and full-scope care.

### Advanced Treatments

We offer many advanced medical modalities, all under one roof, allowing for treatment plans that can
be fully executed, including:

+ [Therapeutic plasma exchange][44]
+ Extensive [IV therapies][45]
+ [Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy][46]
+ [EBOO][47], and much more

### Open to Possibilities

We recognize that standard-of-care medicine in this country, while valuable, may not always offer
solutions to your health conditions and optimization goals. We draw from a variety of medical
disciplines, and will seriously consider your beliefs and preferences regarding your health.

## Targeting the 6 Causes of Brain Inflammation

Cognitive Changes is not a single disease—it is a multifactorial condition with distinct subtypes.
We utilize the **Bredesen Protocol®** to identify your specific type.

### Type 1: Inflammatory

Driven by chronic inflammation from infections, diet, or gut health issues. Often called "Hot"
Cognitive Changes.

### Type 2: Atrophic

Caused by a decline in nutrients, hormones, and trophic factors essential for brain synapses. Often
called "Cold" Cognitive Changes.

A mix of Type 1 and 2, driven by insulin resistance and high blood sugar (sugar toxicity), causing
brain inflammation and atrophy.

### Type 3: Toxic

Resulting from exposure to toxins like heavy metals, mold (mycotoxins), or chemicals that directly
damage brain tissue.

### Type 4: Vascular

Linked to reduced blood flow to the brain, often due to cardiovascular issues, strokes, or "leaky"
blood vessels.

### Type 5: Traumatic

Triggered by previous head injuries or concussions, which initiate a chronic inflammatory response
in the brain.

## Targeting the 6 Causes of Brain Inflammation

Cognitive Changes is not a single disease—it is a multifactorial condition with distinct subtypes.
We utilize the **Bredesen Protocol®** to identify your specific type.

### Type 1: Inflammatory

Driven by chronic inflammation from infections, diet, or gut health issues. Often called "Hot"
Cognitive Changes.

### Type 2: Atrophic

Caused by a decline in nutrients, hormones, and trophic factors essential for brain synapses. Often
called "Cold" Cognitive Changes.

### Type 1.5: Glycotoxic

A mix of Type 1 and 2, driven by insulin resistance and high blood sugar (sugar toxicity), causing
brain inflammation and atrophy.

### Type 3: Toxic

Resulting from exposure to toxins like heavy metals, mold (mycotoxins), or chemicals that directly
damage brain tissue.

### Type 4: Vascular

Linked to reduced blood flow to the brain, often due to cardiovascular issues, strokes, or "leaky"
blood vessels.

### Type 5: Traumatic

Triggered by previous head injuries or concussions, which initiate a chronic inflammatory response
in the brain.

The Foundation

### The Bredesen Protocol®

Conventional medicine often treats cognitive changes as a single problem. The Bredesen Protocol
identifies the **36 metabolic factors** (holes in the roof) that trigger the disease.
* Identifies specific drivers (Inflammation, Toxins, Nutrients)
* Reduces Amyloid Plaques & Neurofibrillary Tangles
* Restores the metabolic support structure of the brain

Early detection changes everything. If you notice signs of the "Stages of cognitive-change

MDLifespan, founded by [Dr. Paul Savage][125], is pioneering health optimization with Advanced
Serial Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE)—a provisional patented therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE)
protocol designed to remove nearly all toxins from the body. Unlike conventional approaches, this
protocol aims to transform health by focusing on what’s taken out of the body to reduce chronic
inflammation and support long-term wellness. Advanced Serial Therapeutic Plasma Exchange targets the
underlying factors of health issues with specific protocols for heart health, cognitive function,
immune support, longevity, and whole-body rejuvenation.

Our approach is guided by three pillars: data, disease, and decision. Using advanced diagnostics, we
assess toxin levels and track biomarker changes throughout your personalized Advanced Serial
Therapeutic Plasma Exchange program. This data-driven personalized medicine provides clear evidence
of your progress and supports your journey to optimal health.

MDLifespan’s Advanced Serial Therapeutic Plasma Exchange protocols are minimally invasive, safe, and
well-tolerated with no downtime.

been successfully used to treat a variety of diseases, including autoimmune diseases, neurological
disorders, hematological disorders, and poisoning.

About Advanced medical Services

[advance medical service next health]

We believe you deserve more when it comes to your health. More years feeling energized and like your
best self. More agency over your biology.

Our Advanced Medical Services leverage the latest in longevity science, guiding you toward a
healthier, longer life.

[learn more about ADVANCED MEDICAL services][129]

About Executive Physical

[next health treatment space]

**The Next Health Executive Physical is the physical exam of the future that has resulted in
life-changing and life-saving results.  **
‍

The Executive Physical consists of biomarker testing, cutting-edge body imaging (Full-Body MRI and
Chest CT scan), in-depth genetic testing, and preventative cancer screening.

**Next Health has helped 35% of Next Health Executive Physical clients with early detection of
potentially life-threatening disease **including: aneurysms, tumors, liver and pancreatic cancer,
and heart disease.

[learn more about Executive Physical][130]

About IV Therapy

[IV Lounge next health]

Experience the future of [vitamin therapy][131] with IV Drips that leave you feeling replenished,
recharged, and rehydrated.

With Next Health, you have the peace of mind that you are getting the best services on the market.
The standard IV experience uses saline as the IV base and charges a premium for adding additional
vitamins and minerals.

All Next Health IVs start with a hydrating mix of fluids and electrolytes, and our multivitamin
(Myer’s Cocktail) base, which includes 8 potent vitamins and minerals.

We continue to elevate your IV experience by adding additional vitamins and minerals tailored to
what you’re looking for such as stress relief, detoxing, immunity support, and more.

[learn more about IV Therapy][132]

About Hormone Therapy

[happy couple]

Balanced hormone levels promote health, vitality, and beauty.

**Optimized hormones can improve sleep, boost energy, aid weight loss, and slow down aging. **

Our hormone levels begin to decline after the age of 30 (due to stress, diet, environmental toxins,
and a variety of other factors).

When you choose to restore your hormone levels with BHRT, our medical experts will create a
personalized Wellness Plan to **balance your hormones and help you live your healthiest life. **

[learn more about Hormone Therapy][133]

About Wellness Tests

[Men treatment next health]

**Think of biomarkers like KPIs when it comes to health.
**
By measuring and tracking your body's key indicators of health with functional medicine tests, you
are **empowered to make informed decisions for your vitality and longevity. **

It is also important to note that common conditions are often detectable in your data years before
symptoms set in, meaning by **taking care of your health now, you are setting yourself up for a
healthier, more vibrant future. **

[learn more about Wellness Tests][134]

About Peptide Therapy

[Next health Peptide]

Looking to target specific health goals such as more energy, hair growth, or muscle mass? 

Peptide Therapy may be the perfect solution for you. 

Because peptides act as messenger signals throughout the body, they can be used to support the
communication of various cells. Peptides may support the cells involved in metabolic function,
repairing tissue, hormone production, and more. 

[learn more about Peptide Therapy][135]

About Wellness Technology

[Therapy rooms next health]

Looking to try the latest and most cutting-edge wellness technology available? You’ve come to the
right place. 

Utilize Cryotherapy originally designed to treat Rheumatoid Arthritis symptoms to reduce
inflammation and boost overall health. Enjoy Infrared Light Therapy invented by NASA for astronauts
to promote mitochondrial function and overall vitality.
‍

With Next Tech, you are at the forefront of health optimization.

[learn more about Wellness Technology][136]

Featured Service

### Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE)

Therapeutic (or Total) Plasma Exchange (TPE) is a medical procedure that removes the liquid part of
blood (plasma), the portion that contains proteins, antibodies, toxins, inflammatory agents, and
other substances—and replaces the old plasma with fresh saline and albumin. Historically, TPE has
been successfully used to treat a variety of diseases, including autoimmune diseases, neurological
disorders, hematological disorders, and poisoning.

About Executive Physical

[next health treatment space]

About IV Therapy

[IV Lounge next health]

Experience the future of [vitamin therapy][131] with IV Drips that leave you feeling replenished,

With Next Health, you have the peace of mind that you are getting the best services on the market.

vitamins and minerals.

All Next Health IVs start with a hydrating mix of fluids and electrolytes, and our multivitamin

[happy couple]

  ## [Fixing Medicare’s Part B HIT Services Benefit][54]
  
  While Congress intended to create a comprehensive Medicare home infusion benefit for Part B DME
  drugs in the 21st Century Cures Act, flawed implementation by CMS has led to limited access for
  Medicare beneficiaries. The Preserving Patient Access to Home Infusion Act would restore
  congressional intent and promote access to home-based care by mirroring the successful model
  employed by nearly every U.S. commercial plan.

# Healing That Honors the Whole You

At Olos, Dr. Kat Hopkins & her team of practitioners offer functional and regenerative medicine for
patients with complex, chronic conditions. They are licensed in Minnesota, Wisconsin, Ohio, and
South Dakota.

## Olos Integrative & Functional Medicine

#### Finding and Healing Root Causes

Are you struggling with complex, chronic, and severe health issues? We are invested in you, your
health, and your experiences. We honor and respect your story. We are mindful of the interconnection
between your life, your experiences and your health. We watch and listen for what is most important
to you and develop solutions that get you the results you are looking for.

##### Deep, Personalized Patient Care

Root-cause medicine that sees the whole you.
Uncover what’s really going on in your body. Through deep listening, advanced testing, and a
systems-based approach, we create a personalized plan that supports healing at every level.

##### Advanced Clinical Therapies

*Science-backed tools to help your body heal itself.*
Our clinic offers cutting-edge therapies like TPE, HBOT, PEMF, PRF, neural therapy, infrared detox,
and more. All of these therapies are designed to restore energy, reduce inflammation, and accelerate
healing at the cellular level.

##### Two Locations to Serve You

Olos offers two locations, each with its own character. Our Hudson office sits in the heart of
downtown, designed as a calm, modern space for advanced therapies, consultations, and day-to-day
patient care. Our Regenerative Farm is a place to reconnect with nature, nourishment, and yourself.
It’s where we live, grow, and heal, and where patients are invited to experience care rooted in
food-as-medicine, community, and whole-person wellness.

#### Coming Fall 2026

## **Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE)**

After months of permits, planning, and building out our vision, **we’ve officially secured our
second location in historic downtown Hudson, Wisconsin.** We’re bringing expanded services to our
patients, including therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE).

**Join the Waitlist for a TPE Webinar with Dr. Kat Hopkins**
Learn about therapeutic plasma exchange, how it works, and if it might help you.

[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][26]

provided by Bridge Building Inc.; EEA residents by Bridge Building Sp. Z.o.o.; and all other
residents by Bridge Building Limited.

4. Plasma does not custody your assets. The stablecoin assets in your Plasma One account are owned
and custodied by you. The value of any cryptocurrency, including stablecoin assets pegged to fiat
currency, commodities, or any other asset, may go to zero. Stablecoin balances are not bank
deposits.

5. Cashback and yield rates vary by Plasma One member tier. Rates are variable and subject to
change. See [Plasma One Rewards Addendum][150] for more details.

6. The Plasma One earn feature is a technology interface that facilitates access to third-party
decentralised finance (DeFi) protocols through third-party vault providers. It is not a bank
account, deposit, or savings product. Funds are not protected by deposit insurance, are not
guaranteed, and may lose value. Yield is generated through participation in DeFi lending protocols.
Returns are variable, depend on market conditions and protocol performance, and are not guaranteed.
Past performance is not indicative of future results. Plasma does not manage, operate, or control
any underlying protocol. Participation involves material risks including smart contract risk,
protocol failure, liquidity risk, counterparty risk, and market volatility, which may result in
partial or total loss of principal. Plasma does not verify the security of, or endorse, any protocol
accessed through Plasma One.

7. Zero-fee USD₮ transfers refer to Plasma routes; third-party fees may apply.

8. Stablecoin and yield products are not covered by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme
(FSCS), the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS), the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), or
equivalent deposit protection or investor compensation schemes in other jurisdictions. Your
stablecoin balance is not a bank deposit.

9. Geographic, regulatory, and other eligibility limits apply, and are subject to change.

## about PPTA

The Plasma Protein Therapeutics Association (PPTA) is a key player in the plasma industry, with an
extensive network of human plasma collection centers and manufacturers. Collaborating with numerous
key stakeholders and policymakers to establish rightful standards and programs for donors and
patients is at the core of our work.

[
Learn more about PPTA
][62]

## Why you should donate plasma

Plasma-derived medicines are often the only therapies for many rare and chronic diseases. By
becoming a donor, you increase the chances of regular access to plasma medicines for those in need,
contributing to the improvement of health outcomes for patients.

## about PPTA

The Plasma Protein Therapeutics Association (PPTA) is a key player in the plasma industry, with an
extensive network of human plasma collection centers and manufacturers. Collaborating with numerous
key stakeholders and policymakers to establish rightful standards and programs for donors and
patients is at the core of our work.

[
Learn more about PPTA
][62]

## Why you should donate plasma

Plasma-derived medicines are often the only therapies for many rare and chronic diseases. By
becoming a donor, you increase the chances of regular access to plasma medicines for those in need,
contributing to the improvement of health outcomes for patients.

**SCOTTSDALE, ARIZONA | SEPTEMBER 4–6, 2026**

[RAADfest 11 2026]

# The Revolution
# Against Aging & Death

**RAADfest 2026  |  The World's #1 Most Impactful Longevity Conference est. 2016**

[ 2026 SPEAKERS ][57]
[ 2026 AGENDA ][58]

#### Longevity has entered a very *different era.*

There's a lot of excitement. A lot of "coming soon." And a lot of bold promises. That noise can
cloud decision-making when it comes to your own health.

So for RAADfest 2026, we made a very intentional decision: **we will focus exclusively on the best
accessible practices and protocols for longevity and age reversal** — grounded in this year's theme:

***What's now. What's new. What works.***

Longevity isn't one single intervention. It's a combination approach — addressing metabolism,
inflammation, recovery, stress response, sleep, nutrition, movement, and cellular health
**together**.

RAADfest 2026 is being designed to reflect that reality. You'll hear from the best — those who are
**actively applying these approaches successfully** — learn how different protocols fit together,
and gain clarity on what's relevant now. Not ten years from now.

If you want accessible strategies and protocols you can use *right now* to support longer, healthier
lives — this is your invitation.

#### ***Featured on***

[RAADfest featured on press and media]

## **What We're ****Focusing On**** in RAADfest 2026**

### *Trackable **Progress*

Strategies where progress can be monitored through commonly available labs and functional markers
you already have access to.

### *Human Data **First*

Protocols already being applied in people — supported by clinical experience, observational data,
and real-world outcomes.

### *Months**, Not Decades*

Approaches where meaningful changes can be experienced and measured within 3–12 months — not distant
promises.

### *Stacked** Impact*

Longevity approaches that address 3–5 interconnected systems at once — metabolism, inflammation,
recovery, stress, movement.

### *Increasing **Access*

Practices whose cost and access barriers have dropped significantly — moving from specialist-only
into consumer-accessible settings.

# Our 2026 sponsors

### Platinum Sponsors

### Silver Sponsors

### Title Sponsor

### Gold Sponsor

#### ***Why RAADfest Is Different***

## Built for *Everyone**.*
## Not Just Scientists.

Most longevity conferences are designed for researchers and clinicians. RAADfest is built for anyone
who refuses to accept that aging is inevitable. No jargon walls. No gatekeeping. Just real science,
delivered by the people doing the work.

We take your biohacking further. We're not here to help you run faster. **We're here to help you
live *radically* longer.**

**Science-Based, Not Hype-Based**

Every speaker is selected for real-world application, not buzz. This is the science that's working
now.

**Accessible**

RAADfest attendees have direct access to speakers, real conversations, and connections that don't
happen at other events.

**Not-for-profit Mission**

RAADfest is produced by the [Coalition for Radical Life Extension][59], a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit.
The mission is the movement, not the margin.

**A Decade of Impact**

Launched 2016, RAADfest has built a reputation as the most relevant longevity conference for the
public, giving access to what actually makes an difference first.

**Radical Life Extension. Not Just Wellness**

We go beyond optimization. RAADfest exists for people who believe aging and death are problems worth
solving.

###### OUR METHOD

### How regenerative care is delivered at RMI

At RMI, care begins with clinical evaluation, not treatment selection. Each patient moves through a
defined pathway designed to assess eligibility, determine appropriateness, and guide care decisions
with medical oversight at every stage.

## Step 01

###### Preparation (TPE)

Therapeutic Plasma Exchange removes inflammatory molecules, dysfunctional proteins, and circulating
senescent factors to prepare the biological environment.

## Step 02

###### Immunomodulation (MSC Infusion)

Expanded umbilical cord–derived mesenchymal stem cells are administered intravenously to support
immune modulation and paracrine signaling.

## Step 03

###### Targeted Reconstruction

For certain protocols, MUSE cells or image-guided orthopedic injections are used to target
structural areas under physician discretion.

## Step 04

###### Structured Follow-Up

Follow-up occurs at: Night of procedure, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months patients have
direct medical access during this period.

“I first heard about this type of therapy a few years ago and did my research. I spoke to Mike Smith
— one of the greatest jockeys of all time — and he swears by it. That meant something to me. When
the time felt right, I didn’t hesitate. I got on a plane and came straight here to RMI.”

## and JapanCup; he claimed three British jockey championships (1994, 1995,2004) and over 3,300
## victories, including 77 at Royal Ascot.

## Frank Dettori

The experience I received at RMI worked an absolute dream. They didn’t just manage my pain; they
actually helped my body repair itself. They are the reason I’m going to be back on the mats and back
where I left off far sooner than anyone expected.

## Known as “The Hitman,” is a legendary British Muay Thai fighter with over 100 professional
## fights, 48 knockouts, and 9 world titles.

## Liam Harrison

“RMI stands out to me for two reasons: they’re operating at the cutting edge of what’s currently
possible with regenerative medicine, and they’re backed by some of the most experienced and
trustworthy longevity physicians in the world.”

## Dave Asprey is renowned as the founder of Bulletproof Coffee and a pioneer in biohacking. Four
## times NYT

## Dave Asprey

“What I appreciate about RMI is that it aligns with how I think about health
professionally: proactive, science-driven, individualized, and focused on the long game. I’m not
here for a quick fix. I’m here because I want to be functional, clear-headed, and capable for as
long as possible. That’s what good medicine should be working toward — and that’s what I’ve found
here.”

## Chief Population Health Officer at Vail Health and Executive Director of Eagle Valley Behavioral
## Health

“I came to RMI and gave it a shot. A few weeks later, I felt brand new. That’s not
something I say lightly — I don’t really believe in much — but what happened here was
real. I woke up feeling well-rested, like a different person.”

“I’ve referred astronauts here. Several have come through, and every one of them has had
a positive experience. I’ve also gone through a number of their therapies personally,
which is why my trust in this team isn’t just professional — it’s personal. I wouldn’t send
my astronauts somewhere I hadn’t vetted myself.”

### Areas of RMI regenerative support & focus

For more than 15 years, RMI has focused on longevity medicine and regenerative therapies, helping
you extend quality of life, preserve independence and secure enduring biological vitality.

Over the past several years, the clinic has developed multimodal and proprietary protocols combining

Our laboratory is deeply committed to quality and continuous improvement, supported by an
interdisciplinary team with more than 100 years of combined experience in cell biology, regenerative
medicine, and clinical applications.

immune modulation and paracrine signaling.

## Step 03

structural areas under physician discretion.

## Step 04

###### Structured Follow-Up

Follow-up occurs at: Night of procedure, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months patients have
direct medical access during this period.

# Trending Now

[[OneView Monitoring System]][47]

### [Introducing the CDI OneView^{™} Monitoring System][48]

An indusrty benchmark of excellence with real-time monitoring of up to 22 vital patient parameters.

Explore an expert-led session on endoscopic vessel harvesting that offers key guidance and surgical
footage to support clinicians at all experience levels.

[WATCH NOW →][51]

[[Managing Supply and Demand]][52]

### [Managing Supply and Demand: A Perfusionist's Balancing Act][53]

Learn how managing DO2i with O2ER empowers perfusionists to make informed adjustments - supporting
reduced lactic acid production and improved patient outcomes.

[READ NOW →][54]

## Technologies for Exceptional Patient Care

Our mission is to work as a team to save one more life, today and every day. We do this by providing
lifesaving technology to cardiac surgery teams around the world.

### Oxygenation Systems

Terumo introduced the world’s first hollow fiber oxygenator, and continues to lead the way in
innovation and quality.
[Learn More →][55]

### Monitoring Systems

Terumo’s CDI Systems are the world’s most trusted and used continuous in-line blood gas monitors.
[Learn More →][56]

### Heart-lung Machines

Terumo manufactures the longest running line of commercially available heart-lung machines in the
world, and is a leader in quality systems management.
[Learn More →][57]

### EVH Products

Terumo’s endoscopic vessel harvesting products are designed for safety and efficiency, delivering
quality results to clinicians and patients.
[Learn More →][58]

## SOLUTIONS

# INNOVATIONS IN CARING

### TERUMO INTERVENTIONAL SYSTEMS (TIS)

TIS is a market leader in providing solutions that enable minimally invasive entry site management,
lesion access and therapeutic intervention for cardiology, peripheral arterial disease,
embolotherapy and interventional oncology.

### TERUMO HEALTH OUTCOMES (THO)

THO partners with clinicians and hospitals to help them improve patient outcomes, optimize
operations and provide process investment guidance that can lead to cost savings. 

### TERUMO MEDICAL PRODUCTS (TMP)

TMP designs injection and infusion therapy devices that allow clinicians to deliver the very best
day-to-day care to their patients in both the human and animal health markets.

### PHARMACEUTICAL SOLUTIONS DIVISION (PSD)

PSD offers pharmaceutical and medical device companies worldwide comprehensive product design and
development services.

Looking for a rewarding and meaningful career? Then Terumo is where you want to be. When you join

## SOLUTIONS

# INNOVATIONS IN CARING

### TERUMO INTERVENTIONAL SYSTEMS (TIS)

TIS is a market leader in providing solutions that enable minimally invasive entry site management,
lesion access and therapeutic intervention for cardiology, peripheral arterial disease,
embolotherapy and interventional oncology.

### TERUMO HEALTH OUTCOMES (THO)

THO partners with clinicians and hospitals to help them improve patient outcomes, optimize
operations and provide process investment guidance that can lead to cost savings. 

### TERUMO MEDICAL PRODUCTS (TMP)

TMP designs injection and infusion therapy devices that allow clinicians to deliver the very best
day-to-day care to their patients in both the human and animal health markets.

### PHARMACEUTICAL SOLUTIONS DIVISION (PSD)

PSD offers pharmaceutical and medical device companies worldwide comprehensive product design and
development services.

#### CAREERS

Looking for a rewarding and meaningful career? Then Terumo is where you want to be. When you join
our team, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique skillset to make a real difference at
one of the most admired medical device companies in the industry. 

[ Join Terumo ][75]

Advanced wellness devices including cryotherapy chambers, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, lymphatic

clinical body-contouring machines designed for Hospitals and Wellness Devices.

## Hyper O₂ Chamber - HBOT Machine for Wellness, Fitness & Aesthetic Clinics

Hyper O₂ Hyperbaric Oxygen Chamber is a CE & FDA-approved HBOT therapy machine engineered for
Hospitals, and wellness centres. Available in 1.3 ATA, 1.5 ATA and 2.0 ATA, this hyperbaric oxygen
therapy system enhances wound healing, anti-aging, skin rejuvenation, muscle recovery and chronic
fatigue treatment. Ideal for wellness centres, sports recovery labs and aesthetic clinics searching
for top hyperbaric oxygen chamber technology.

[See more ][8]
[Hyper O2 Chamber HBOT Machine]
[nabula Electric Cryotherapy Machine Treatment]
Exclusive Edition

## Nabula Electric Cryotherapy Chamber - Sports Recovery & Pain Relief

Nabula Electric Cryotherapy Chamber, a USFDA-approved whole-body cold therapy system, delivers
ultra-low temperatures up to -70°C using advanced electric refrigeration technology a safer, more
efficient alternative to nitrogen cryotherapy machines. Designed for dermatology clinics, wellness
centres, aesthetic studios, gyms and sports recovery labs, this electric cryo chamber enhances
anti-aging, metabolism, muscle recovery, fat loss, pain relief and stress reduction.

[See more ][9]
Exclusive Edition

## Full Body EMS Suit Training Machine for Gyms & Wellness Centres

EMS Suit Training Machine, an FDA-approved full-body EMS training system, delivers advanced
electrical muscle stimulation for rapid fitness results. Designed for gyms, wellness studios,
physiotherapy centres, slimming clinics and performance labs, this hybrid EMS machine supports both
wired & wireless suits and trains up to 11 clients simultaneously. A 20-minute EMS session equals
the results of a 90-minute traditional workout, making it a powerful solution for body toning, fat
loss, posture correction and functional fitness.

[See more ][10]
[EMS Suit Traing Machine]

## Hyper O₂ Chamber - HBOT Machine for Wellness, Fitness & Aesthetic Clinics

Hyper O₂ Hyperbaric Oxygen Chamber is a CE & FDA-approved HBOT therapy machine engineered for
Hospitals, and wellness centres. Available in 1.3 ATA, 1.5 ATA and 2.0 ATA, this hyperbaric oxygen
therapy system enhances wound healing, anti-aging, skin rejuvenation, muscle recovery and chronic
fatigue treatment. Ideal for wellness centres, sports recovery labs and aesthetic clinics searching
for top hyperbaric oxygen chamber technology.

## Nabula Electric Cryotherapy Chamber - Sports Recovery & Pain Relief

Nabula Electric Cryotherapy Chamber, a USFDA-approved whole-body cold therapy system, delivers
ultra-low temperatures up to -70°C using advanced electric refrigeration technology a safer, more
efficient alternative to nitrogen cryotherapy machines. Designed for dermatology clinics, wellness
centres, aesthetic studios, gyms and sports recovery labs, this electric cryo chamber enhances
anti-aging, metabolism, muscle recovery, fat loss, pain relief and stress reduction.

[See more ][9]
Exclusive Edition

## Full Body EMS Suit Training Machine for Gyms & Wellness Centres

EMS Suit Training Machine, an FDA-approved full-body EMS training system, delivers advanced
electrical muscle stimulation for rapid fitness results. Designed for gyms, wellness studios,
physiotherapy centres, slimming clinics and performance labs, this hybrid EMS machine supports both
wired & wireless suits and trains up to 11 clients simultaneously. A 20-minute EMS session equals
the results of a 90-minute traditional workout, making it a powerful solution for body toning, fat
loss, posture correction and functional fitness.

OUR MISSION:

# EXTENDING LIVES >>> EXPANDING POSSIBILITIES

We show up every day to expand what’s possible for clinicians in the care they deliver ... and for
patients in the lives they live.

## The next evolution of a kidney care legacy

Introducing Vantive, a newly independent healthcare company focused on vital organ therapies. Over
the last seven decades, we have built a legacy of exceptional kidney care products and services. Now
we are deepening our commitment to elevating the patient and clinician dialysis experience through
digital solutions and advanced services while evolving our organ support therapies to go beyond
kidney care.

[Healthcare professional and a patent sit on a bench in an outdoor space with trees in the
background]

## Prioritizing the patient and the clinician

Support longer, richer lives — that is what Vantive aspires to make happen for patients everywhere.
This is why we collaborate with our clinician partners to energize innovation and evolve best
practices. From therapies that expand possibilities, to digital solutions that unlock efficiencies,

What is Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE)?
Therapeutic Plasma Exchange, or TPE, is a physician supervised blood filtration therapy that removes
and replaces plasma. The process is designed to help reduce inflammatory substances, immune
complexes, and certain toxins in the bloodstream. Many patients explore TPE as part of an immune
support, inflammation reduction, or wellness focused care plan in Boca Raton and surrounding South
Florida areas.
Who may benefit from plasma exchange therapy?
Plasma exchange may be considered by individuals dealing with chronic inflammation, immune system
imbalance, neurological concerns, or those focused on longevity and health optimization. At VIP TPE
in Boca Raton, every patient is carefully screened to determine whether TPE is appropriate for their
specific health goals.
How safe is Therapeutic Plasma Exchange?
When performed under proper medical supervision, TPE is considered a well established medical
procedure. At VIP TPE, treatments are guided by experienced physicians with advanced training in
plasma exchange and strict safety protocols to ensure patient comfort and monitoring throughout the
process.
Is TPE considered an anti aging or longevity therapy?
Some patients explore plasma exchange as part of a broader anti aging or longevity focused program.
By helping reduce inflammation and unwanted substances in the blood, TPE may support overall
vitality and long term wellness when combined with other physician guided strategies.
How do Peptides contribute to Anti-Aging?
Peptides are short chains of amino acids that act as signaling molecules, instructing your cells to
perform specific rejuvenative functions. Our targeted protocols can help stimulate natural growth
hormone production, accelerate tissue repair, improve skin elasticity, and enhance cognitive
function, effectively reversing biological markers of aging.
What makes Cord Stem Cells effective for regeneration?
Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs) are young, potent cells with superior anti-inflammatory
and immunomodulatory properties. Unlike older adult stem cells, they have a higher capacity to
migrate to sites of injury and promote profound tissue healing and systemic rejuvenation.
Why is Genomic Sequencing the first step?
Your DNA is your biological blueprint. Comprehensive genomic sequencing allows us to identify your
unique genetic predispositions and metabolic pathways. This data enables us to customize every
aspect of your longevity protocol—from nutrition to specific therapies—ensuring we work with your
biology, not against it.
Where is VIP TPE located and who do you serve?
VIP TPE is based in Boca Raton and serves patients from across South Florida, including Deerfield
Beach, Delray Beach, Highland Beach, Parkland, Coconut Creek, and Pompano Beach. Many patients
search for TPE near me in Boca Raton when looking for advanced plasma exchange care.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about our protocols and services.

What is Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE)?
Therapeutic Plasma Exchange, or TPE, is a physician supervised blood filtration therapy that removes
and replaces plasma. The process is designed to help reduce inflammatory substances, immune
complexes, and certain toxins in the bloodstream. Many patients explore TPE as part of an immune
support, inflammation reduction, or wellness focused care plan in Boca Raton and surrounding South
Florida areas.
Who may benefit from plasma exchange therapy?
Plasma exchange may be considered by individuals dealing with chronic inflammation, immune system
imbalance, neurological concerns, or those focused on longevity and health optimization. At VIP TPE
in Boca Raton, every patient is carefully screened to determine whether TPE is appropriate for their
specific health goals.
How safe is Therapeutic Plasma Exchange?
When performed under proper medical supervision, TPE is considered a well established medical
procedure. At VIP TPE, treatments are guided by experienced physicians with advanced training in
plasma exchange and strict safety protocols to ensure patient comfort and monitoring throughout the
process.
Is TPE considered an anti aging or longevity therapy?
Some patients explore plasma exchange as part of a broader anti aging or longevity focused program.
By helping reduce inflammation and unwanted substances in the blood, TPE may support overall
vitality and long term wellness when combined with other physician guided strategies.
How do Peptides contribute to Anti-Aging?
Peptides are short chains of amino acids that act as signaling molecules, instructing your cells to
perform specific rejuvenative functions. Our targeted protocols can help stimulate natural growth
hormone production, accelerate tissue repair, improve skin elasticity, and enhance cognitive
function, effectively reversing biological markers of aging.
What makes Cord Stem Cells effective for regeneration?
Umbilical Cord Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs) are young, potent cells with superior anti-inflammatory
and immunomodulatory properties. Unlike older adult stem cells, they have a higher capacity to
migrate to sites of injury and promote profound tissue healing and systemic rejuvenation.
Why is Genomic Sequencing the first step?
Your DNA is your biological blueprint. Comprehensive genomic sequencing allows us to identify your
unique genetic predispositions and metabolic pathways. This data enables us to customize every
aspect of your longevity protocol—from nutrition to specific therapies—ensuring we work with your
biology, not against it.
Where is VIP TPE located and who do you serve?
VIP TPE is based in Boca Raton and serves patients from across South Florida, including Deerfield
Beach, Delray Beach, Highland Beach, Parkland, Coconut Creek, and Pompano Beach. Many patients
search for TPE near me in Boca Raton when looking for advanced plasma exchange care.

* **Mechanism**: Eboo Therapy may significantly enhance your immune system by increasing the

* **Mechanism**: This therapy facilitates the removal of toxic substances and free radicals from

* **Mechanism**: The ozonation process in Eboo Therapy can increase the amount of oxygen carried by

The Benefits of Eboo Therapy

EBOO Therapy, also known as Extracorporeal Blood Oxygenation and Ozonation, is a novel medical
treatment that enhances the body’s natural healing processes. It is particularly beneficial for
conditions like mold toxicity, Lyme disease, autoimmune disorders, chronic viral infections, and
environmental toxins. This therapy is presented as a safe, natural, and potentially transformative
option for those seeking comprehensive healthcare solutions.

#### [Immune System Boosting][29]
* **Mechanism**: Eboo Therapy may significantly enhance your immune system by increasing the
  production of white blood cells and cytokines.
* **Implication**: Enhanced immunity may better prepare your body to fight off infections, bacteria,
  and viruses.

#### [Detoxification][30]
* **Mechanism**: This therapy facilitates the removal of toxic substances and free radicals from
  your bloodstream.
* **Implication**: A cleaner system can improve liver function, kidney efficiency, and overall
  metabolic processes.

#### [Enhanced Oxygenation][31]
* **Mechanism**: The ozonation process in Eboo Therapy can increase the amount of oxygen carried by
  your blood.
* **Implication**: Enhanced oxygenation can improve cellular function, potentially increasing energy
  levels and reducing fatigue.

phẩm và giải pháp công nghệ y tế.

### Đồng hành cùng cộng đồng

Chúng tôi cung cấp các giải pháp y tế tiên tiến và chất lượng từ đối tác chiến lược là các thương
hiệu hàng đầu thế giới, phục vụ đa dạng lĩnh vực và nhu cầu trong y khoa.

### Cam kết về chất lượng

Với phương châm “Delivering quality of life - Đem Chất lượng cho Cuộc sống”, chúng tôi không ngừng
nâng cao tiêu chuẩn phân phối, khẳng định vai trò tiên phong và đóng góp tích cực vào sự phát triển
chung của hệ thống y tế Việt Nam.

## 30 năm phân phối chuyên nghiệp

Công ty CP Y Tế Việt Tiến (VT healthcare JSC) đã chứng tỏ được vị trí của mình trên bản đồ y tế Việt
Nam với 30 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên nghiệp trong lĩnh vực phân phối thiết bị, vật tư tiêu hao, dược
phẩm và giải pháp công nghệ y tế.

### Đồng hành cùng cộng đồng

Chúng tôi cung cấp các giải pháp y tế tiên tiến và chất lượng từ đối tác chiến lược là các thương
hiệu hàng đầu thế giới, phục vụ đa dạng lĩnh vực và nhu cầu trong y khoa.

### Cam kết về chất lượng

Với phương châm “Delivering quality of life - Đem Chất lượng cho Cuộc sống”, chúng tôi không ngừng
nâng cao tiêu chuẩn phân phối, khẳng định vai trò tiên phong và đóng góp tích cực vào sự phát triển
chung của hệ thống y tế Việt Nam.
